source.active_destination: slice-925 path validation plus backend/provider diagnostics

active_security_checks.contract: Reject empty paths, excessive length, null bytes, relative paths, traversal segments, unsupported extensions, and unsafe filenames.
Validate language names, symbol names, and backend names before use.
Backend names are valid only when auto or present in the active backend registry.
Validators return every independently detectable error in stable order.
